user.title: Add printer
user.description: Enter the address of a network printer that supports IPP.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add discovered printer
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check the address and that the printer is on.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check that it is on.

data.scan_max_mb: Max space for scans (MB, 0 = no limit)

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Prints a PDF, JPEG or PNG file from a folder Home Assistant is allowed to read.

path.name: File path
path.description: Full path of a file under the media folder (or another folder Home Assistant may read).

sides.name: Sides
sides.description: One-sided or two-sided. Uses this printer's default from the integration options when empty.

color_mode.name: Color mode
color_mode.description: Color or black and white. Uses this printer's default from the integration options when empty.

page_ranges.name: Pages
page_ranges.description: Pages to print, for example 1-3,5. Prints all pages when empty.

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Scans a document with the printer's scanner and saves it in the media folder. Optionally copies it to another folder.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: The printer whose scanner to use.

source.name: Source
source.description: Glass, document feeder or two-sided feeder. Uses the glass when empty.

color_mode.name: Color mode
color_mode.description: Color, grayscale or black and white. Uses color when empty.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution in dpi. Uses 300 (or the closest the scanner offers) when empty.

format.name: Format
format.description: PDF or JPEG. A JPEG is only possible for a single page. Uses PDF when empty.

file_name.name: File name
file_name.description: Name of the scan without extension. Uses the date and time when empty.

folder.name: Copy to folder
folder.description: Also copies the scan to this folder. It must be a folder Home Assistant may write to.

file_too_large.message: The file is too large. You can send at most {max} MB.

unsupported_file_type.message: This file type can't be printed. Send a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.

option_not_supported.message: The printer doesn't support the {option} option.

printer_unavailable.message: Can't reach the printer. Check that it is on and connected.

print_timeout.message: The printer didn't confirm the job in time. It may still have printed, so check the printer before trying again.

print_failed.message: Printing failed because of an unexpected printer error.

invalid_document.message: The file couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or password protected.

too_many_pages.message: This document is too long. You can print at most {limit} pages.

image_too_large.message: This image is too large to print. Use an image of at most {limit} megapixels.

output_too_large.message: The converted document got too large (at most {limit} MB). Choose fewer pages or print in black and white.

invalid_request.message: The upload request is not valid.

admin_required.message: Only administrators can print on this printer.

entry_not_loaded.message: This printer is not ready yet.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {path}.

scan_error_scanner_busy.message: The scanner is busy. Try again in a moment.

scan_error_scanner_unavailable.message: Can't reach the scanner. Check that the printer is on and connected.

scan_error_adf_empty.message: The document feeder is empty. Load the paper and try again.

scan_error_invalid_option.message: The scanner doesn't support these scan settings.

scan_error_bad_scan.message: The scanner sent a page that couldn't be read.

scan_error_too_large.message: The scanned page is too large. Choose a lower resolution.

scan_error_too_many_pages.message: The document has too many pages.

scan_error_not_found.message: The scan to add pages to was not found.

scan_error_scan_failed.message: Scanning failed because of an unexpected error.

scan_error_copy_failed.message: The scan was saved, but copying it to {path} failed.
